title: WOMBO COMBO
blurb: Cracking-voiced, absolutely unhinged commentary from a Super Smash Bros. Melee tournament, and arguably the original hype meme of competitive gaming. What makes it timeless is the sincerity — nobody was performing for an audience, the shouting is just what happens when something impossible occurs in front of people who understand exactly how impossible it is. Play it when anything chains together perfectly: a combo, a plan, a sequence of events that had no business working and did anyway. Fifteen-odd years on, it still carries the whole room.
origin: From the legendary Super Smash Bros. Melee 'Wombo Combo' clip.
